Ключ 3. Что доступно 4. Где применять Ключ контура Сохранённый ключ не показывается никогда — ни здесь, ни в одном ответе панели. Оставьте поле пустым, чтобы сохранённый остался на месте. Где взять ключ Всё делается в админке контура, обычно https://inst.<ваш-домен>. /providers Провайдер моделей заведён и активен. /models Модель создана и отвечает в чате платформы. /users У ключа назначен владелец — иначе знания компании ему недоступны. /keys Ключ создан, бюджет и лимиты выставлены, значение скопировано. What this section does and what it does not Team contour not active Company platform http://gateway.corp.internal:8080 no key saved Make it active Check Configure Delete spend ≈ 0.00 $ — no budget set from the start of our records, by our price book — an estimate The panel claims nothing about a contour it has not visited. Press “Check the connection” — the matrix fills with your contour’s answer to your key. Applied to The configs will carry no model: the contour assigned none, so the CLI goes with its own. — Panel assistant the gateway is down or the contour is not active — Claude Code the gateway is down or the contour is not active — Codex (OpenAI) the gateway is down or the contour is not active — Gemini CLI speaks a dialect the gateway does not understand — Qwen Code the gateway is down or the contour is not active — Continue the gateway is down or the contour is not active — Goose this CLI has no environment file at all — Kimi Code this CLI has no environment file at all — Cursor this CLI has no environment file at all — OpenCode this CLI has no environment file at all — Aider the gateway is down or the contour is not active ✔ — works fully, ⚠ — tools through the shim or none at all (the mark beside it says which), ○ — can be applied, — unavailable with a reason. What is already decided The contour key stays in the panel: CLIs go to its local gateway, never to the contour itself Client tools cannot be declared to the company platform as a field: the panel declares them to the model as protocol text and reassembles the call out of the answer — an agent through a contour does edit files. A compatible gateway gets them as a field, as the vendor does Not every CLI takes a gateway address: four of the ten document no such setting, and the list shows them as a dash with its reason Compromises (22) Panel agent Write in plain words — the agent does it in the panel with the same actions you would. I never take the key — you type it. Action: Save a contour draft Opened page /platform Save a contour draft: saved, a key is needed — you type it Saved without the key. The panel opened its own field — type the key there, never send it to me. The key field is open in the panel. Contour settings Address and key, a probe of capabilities, the choice of consumers — four steps. 1. Address 2. Key 3. What is available 4. Where to apply Contour key A saved key is never shown — not here, not in any panel response. Leave the field empty to keep the saved one. The key stays in the panel: CLIs go to its local gateway, and the gateway substitutes the key. Where to get the key Everything happens in the contour admin console, usually https://inst.<your-domain>. /providers The model provider is registered and active. /models The model is created and answers in the platform chat. /users The key has an owner — without one company knowledge is out of its reach. /keys The key is created, budget and limits are set, the value is copied. The owner is not a formality: knowledge tools act on their behalf, and a key without an owner finds nothing. Back Next
